title: Road-trip towns 2: Las Vegas to Santa Monica
prompt: An isometric view from the high three-quarter camera of a Minecraft-Dungeons-like game, everything built from chunky blocks with hand-painted pixel textures, a long American highway running from right to left across the picture, small blocky heroes (Percy, Annabeth and Grover) walking along the shoulder for scale. Four town scenes in a two-by-two grid: the Las Vegas strip at dusk, neon everywhere and the Lotus Hotel and Casino with a glowing lotus sign; the Nevada desert with a lonely gas station and Crusty's Water Bed Palace, a warehouse with waterbeds in the yard; Los Angeles with palm trees, hills with big white letters (no readable word) and the black glass front of DOA Recording Studios; Santa Monica's pier with a Ferris wheel and the beach at sunset, a wild storm out at sea. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
generation_prompt:

Use the attached voxel key or voxel map for 3D rendering style; any cartoon scenes supply landmarks only.
